title: Design System: Tarot MCP Visual Reading

body.purpose: Instructions, meanings, forms, and task guidance.

label.purpose: Controls, counts, spread names, and compact status.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: A card resting in the fan.

shadows.name: card-placed
shadows.purpose: A selected card placed on the reading cloth.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover, keyboard focus, or active physical lift only.

shadows.name: card-reveal
shadows.purpose: A revealed card on the completed spread.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: The card-details layer above the table.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Color, border, and short control feedback.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Small light and scale accents that settle quickly.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Signature ritual apertures, sweeps, and seals.

motion.name: deck-riffle
motion.purpose: One shuffle, split into three beats — split, riffle, bridge — each timed as a fraction of this duration.

motion.name: pile-lift
motion.purpose: The cut packet following the reader's drag off the settled deck.

motion.name: ritual-opening
motion.purpose: The settled cut packet gathers, then every visible card sweeps into a short match-cut arc before the full fan appears.

motion.name: fan-arrival
motion.purpose: One lamplight sweep across the newly opened fan.

motion.name: selection-seal
motion.purpose: Immediate acknowledgment on the chosen card back.

motion.name: deal-flight
motion.purpose: FLIP movement and bounded lamplight between fan and cloth.

motion.name: reveal-halo
motion.purpose: A single radial light resolution around the revealed card.

motion.name: confirming-orbit
motion.purpose: A restrained loading indicator used only while awaiting confirmation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The next decisive action in the ritual.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--gold); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--gold); padding: 10px 20px; color: var(--on-gold); font: 650 .9rem var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 170ms ease, transform 170ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--gold) 88%, white); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A reversible or lower-priority ritual action.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; padding: 10px 20px; color: var(--ink); font: 650 .9rem var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 170ms ease, color 170ms ease; } .ds-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--gold-line); color: var(--gold); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Deck Card
components.description: An opaque physical card with gold linework and state-based lift.
components.css: .ds-deck-card { position: relative; width: 92px; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--gold-line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--on-gold); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 52%); transition: border-color 170ms ease, box-shadow 170ms ease, transform 170ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-deck-card::before { position: absolute; inset: 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--gold-line) 70%, transparent); border-radius: 3px; content: ""; } .ds-deck-card:hover { border-color: var(--gold); box-shadow: 0 14px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 62%); transform: translateY(-8px); } .ds-deck-card span { position: absolute; right: 7px; bottom: 7px; display: grid; width: 22px; aspect-ratio: 1; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gold); color: var(--on-gold); font: 800 .68rem var(--font-ui); }

components.name: Reading Cloth
components.description: The lamplit stage that receives selected cards.
components.css: .ds-cloth { position: relative; width: min(560px, 100%); aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--gold-line) 42%, var(--line)); border-radius: 14px; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 68% 58% at 50% 6%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--gold) 10%, transparent), transparent 68%), var(--surface); } .ds-slot { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; display: grid; width: 52px; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; place-items: center; border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--gold-line) 55%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--muted); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); font: 600 .72rem var(--font-ui); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A familiar raised-indigo field with an explicit gold focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" value="What should I understand today?" aria-label="Question">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-raised); padding: 13px 14px; color: var(--ink); font: 400 1rem/1.45 var(--font-ui); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.northStar: The Lamplit Oracle / 灯下神谕
narrative.overview: A midnight reading table illuminated by one controlled source of antique-gold light. The system uses deep indigo stock, fine brass-like linework, ivory type, and illustrated cards treated as physical artifacts. Richness comes from composition, lamplight, card material, and precise state choreography rather than unrelated decoration.
keyCharacteristics: One dark-indigo environment with antique gold reserved for action, focus, and revelation.
The illustrated deck is always the visual protagonist.
Tonal surfaces stay flat at rest; physical lift appears only as interaction feedback.
Serif display establishes ritual while sans-serif UI type protects clarity.
One responsive ritual spans Web and compact MCP embeds.

rules.name: The Lamplight Rule
rules.body: Antique Gold communicates intention or revelation; it does not decorate inactive interface regions.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif marks narrative hierarchy; sans-serif carries every action and piece of operating information.

rules.name: The State-Lift Rule
rules.body: Tonal layering establishes structure; shadow is evidence that an object has changed elevation.

dos: Do use the midnight-indigo family as the complete neutral depth system.
Do reserve Antique Gold for actions, focus, selection, and reveal.
Do use transform-based FLIP motion, bounded single-shot lamplight effects, and a reduced-motion alternative.
Do retain 44px targets, visible focus, keyboard control, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
donts: Don't resemble casino wins, mobile-game loot openings, or confetti-like particle effects.
Don't use generic glassmorphism or cartoon magic.
Don't use random motion, continuous particles, or slow spectacle that delays action.
Don't compete with the illustrated deck with replacement art or sketchy SVG ornament.
